name: True Shuffle
author: Alfamin
description: Shuffle your way: Equal chance, No repeats, Discovery, Never played or For you, over the queue, a playlist or the whole library. Songs you add yourself play first, in your order. By Alfamin.

settings.label: Mode
settings.description: Equal chance: every song once, in a fair random order. No repeats: songs you heard wait until the rest have played. Discovery: least played first. Never played: only songs you never played. For you: picked from how you listen on this computer.

settings.label: Shuffle
settings.description: What the Shuffle button in the True Shuffle window shuffles first. A playlist can be picked there too.

settings.label: For you: new songs
settings.description: How often For you plays a song you have not heard yet: about one in ten, one in five or one in three.

settings.label: Leave out songs marked Not liked
settings.description: Off: they have the same chance as any other song.
